name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Commission delegated regulation of 3 February 2026 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2024/3012 of the European Parliament and of the Council by establishing the certification methodologies for permanent carbon removals activities
part_text:
The European Parliament is blocking new EU rules on certifying permanent carbon removal. It says the Commission's proposed methods, especially for biochar (charcoal-like material added to soil), break basic principles of the 2024 certification law. Biochar is treated as permanent, but there is no monitoring once it is in soil, so no one can be held responsible if the carbon is released again. The rules also fail to count all emissions over a project's full lifecycle and allow biomass from harmful sources such as forest monocultures.

- The Commission's certification methods for permanent carbon removals cannot enter into force.
- Companies seeking EU certification for biochar and similar removals are affected.
- The Commission must revise the rules; Parliament notifies Member States.
